√śri 'resort'
present: [1.] śráyati etc. AV.+ śráyate etc. V.+ 
perfect: śiśrā́ya śiśriyé etc. 
aorist: [1.] áśret áśriyan etc. śrīyāt áśrāyi -- [3.] áśiśriyat etc. AV.+ aśiśret aśiśrema aśiśrayus aśiśriyus aśiśriyan śiśrītá? -- [4.] aśrait -- [5.] aśrayiṣṭa aśrāyiṣṭa 
future: [1.] śrayiṣyati śrayiṣyate etc. B.+ -- [2.] śrayitā 
verbal: śritá V.+ śrayitum śrayitavaí śrayitvā E.+ śritvā -śrítya B.+ 
secondary: passive: śrīyate etc. B.+ śriyate etc. -- intensive: śeśri- -- desiderative: śiśrayiṣa- śiśrīṣa- -- causative: śrāpayati śrāyayati aśiśrayat 
derivatives: -śrī -śraya AV.+ -śrayin C. śrāyá V.+ -śāra AV. śā́lā AV.+ śrayaṇa B.+ śrayaṇīya C. śaraṇá V.+ -śrit V.+ śrití RV.C. -śrayitavya C. śretṛ E. śréṇi V.+ śárman V.+ śárira? V.+ 
The derivatives from the root-form śṛ are probably best referred to a separate root śṛ or śar, śal, meaning 'cover' or the like.

√śrī1 'mix'
present: [9.] śrīṇā́ti śrīṇīté 
perfect: śiśriye 
aorist: [3.] aśiśrayus 
verbal: śrītá śīrta śrītvā 
derivatives: -śir -śira S.+ -śrī V. śrayaṇa S. 
Is probably only a form of √śri, from which it is at some points hardly separable. The interrelations of the roots sṛ, śrā, śri, śrī are intricate, and not yet fully worked out. Eepecially doubtful is it what is the connection with them of the noun śrī́ V.+ 'fortune', and the related śriyás RV., śréyas V.+, śréṣṭha V.+, śremán B.
